basic_info.description:
Modern, super quiet boutique building, very close to everything.

One bedroom/one bath in a newly constructed boutique building (2015) featuring large roof deck with sweeping downtown views, wifi, and a heated rooftop pool. The apartment features gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances including gas range, microwave, and dishwasher, in-unit Bosch laundry washer and dryer, hardwood floors with radiant heat by Nest, and Elfa closet systems.

Just steps to Dolores Park, Valencia, and all the best coffee shops, yoga studios, bars, and restaurants that the Mission has to offer. FANG bus shuttle stops and UCSF Mission Bay shuttle a block away. Very close to BART, many Muni lines, and the freeways. Bicycle storage in garage. Google fiber Internet and water/trash included; tenant pays PG&E. No pets and no smoking in the unit.

One year lease then month-to-month. Move-in is 1st month's rent and damage deposit equal to rent. Parking may be available in below-building garage at additional cost. Thanks for looking.
